statement: The seed-owned formation-release handoff contract and its joiner consumer projection are a registered protected interaction: test/shards/impact-contracts.json carries a contract entry formation-release-handoff (owners: formation-release-handoff-closure-owner.js, formation-release-handoff-contract.js, formation-release-handoff-evidence.js, formation-release-handoff-publication.js, control-plane-readiness-formation-release-methods.js, node-joining-operation-ledger-formation-readiness.js; tests: the closure and consumer-parity witnesses) and a coupled pair formation-release-seed-contract-joiner-consumer whose endpoints are the seed authority owner and the joiner consumer/barrier, so the proof cone and the Solver landing guard select both witnesses whenever either endpoint changes; audit:impact-contracts passes and no owner semantics change.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Only test/shards/impact-contracts.json, the regenerated shard manifests, the evidence harness and its witness change; no src/ owner file changes and no witness semantics change.
The registered contract names the seed-owned formation-release handoff owner and the joiner consumer/barrier as its two endpoints without introducing any third authority.
